purpose: Read-only source discovery and bounded service validation; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The City Council of Johor Bahru GeoJB public ArcGIS portal exposes a public item titled LOT KADASTER. Its app configuration names a Lot JUPEM FeatureServer layer and describes the data as the National Digital Cadastral Database provided by JUPEM. A bounded anonymous query at the ranked point returned ArcGIS HTTP 499 Token Required; no token or login was attempted. No full parcel polygons were retained.
